# trust-bricks (deploy-only)

This repo exists to serve two diagram pages on GitHub Pages:

- https://wjatx.github.io/trust-bricks/ (the safe-agents composition model)
- https://wjatx.github.io/trust-bricks/data-flow.html (the PTC & GAL data flow)

**Do not edit the HTML here.** The canonical source is the private repo
[`wjatx/ptc-gal-standards`](https://github.com/wjatx/ptc-gal-standards): `trust-bricks.html`
maps to `index.html` here, and `data-flow.html` maps to `data-flow.html`. To update, edit there,
copy the files over byte-identically, and push both repos. An edit made here will be overwritten
by the next sync.
